summary: Iteration 40 — verified SIPRO payment-scheme sync + customer profile tabs (Kontrak & Harga, Unit & Konstruksi), manual complaints (profile + global), lead PIC assignment, quotations options, and reservation scheme preview. Authored pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter40_sipro.py (9 passed). Backend coverage: (a) GET /customers/{cid}/contract-pricing for customer 666796c3-… returns 1 deal with scheme 'Cash Bertahap (3x)', sync.ok=true, 3 term rows, contract KTR/2026/0004, ar totals present. (b) GET /customers/{cid}/units-construction for c5149a80-… returns unit A-01 with 20 build items, photos, handover key present. (c) POST /complaints validation (400 empty subject / 400 invalid channel / 404 unknown customer) + happy path returns source='manual', channel='telepon', sla_due_at set, assigned_to populated; subsequently visible via GET /complaints?customer_id= and a work-task 'Komplain pembeli: <subject>' is auto-created. (d) GET /leads/assignees — superadmin sees ≥2 assignees each with value/label/role; sales@sipro.co.id sees only self. (e) POST /leads assigned_to='sales2@sipro.co.id' respected. (f) GET /quotations/options — schemes carry kind/kind_label and items (non-empty). (g) `python3 /app/scripts/verify_scheme_sync.py` executed for both 'Standar KPR (DP 20%)' and 'Cash keras (DP 80% + pelunasan)' → exit 0; contract-pricing on generated customers returns sync.ok=true. Frontend E2E via Playwright at preview URL: Kontrak & Harga tab shows cust-cp-* testids (deal card / scheme badge 'Cash Bertahap (3x)' / sync-ok / 3 term rows / 8 cost rows / contract KTR/2026/0004 / AR box); costs dialog opens, BPHTB=36500000 saved → contract box shows Rp 36.500.000. Unit & Konstruksi tab shows unit A-01, progress 33%, 6→20 stage rows via toggle, 7 milestones, 8 photos (first naturalWidth=480), handover box and cust-uc-open-build link. Manual complaint on customer profile: dialog prelocks customer (no search field), subject/message + channel Telepon → submits and new row visible. Global /complaints manual dialog: customer search 'Dewi' returns options; submit creates a complaint with the given subject visible in list. /leads Tambah Lead dialog exposes data-testid lead-form-pic listing 5 options including 'Andi Sales · sales', 'Dewi Sales · sales', 'Sinta Manajer · sales_manager', 'Rani Marketing · marketing_admin'; selecting Dewi and submitting creates a lead with assigned_to=sales2@sipro.co.id (confirmed via API GET /leads?q=). Reservation dialog reserve-scheme-select options render '<name> · <kind label>' (5 options observed) and picking a scheme reveals pricing-scheme-preview with 3 pricing-scheme-preview-row rows.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_hub_router._deal_block correctly composes deal/scheme/contract/AR blocks and computes sync issues (deal-vs-contract kind, scheme_id divergence, name↔kind mismatch) with meaningful Indonesian messages.

complaints_router.create_manual_complaint validates subject/message/channel/customer, resolves deal by explicit deal_id → unit_id → most-recent-active, enforces scoped-sales access, auto-creates SLA task via auto_create_task(SM-09) and notifies assignee — feature parity with buyer-portal path except source='manual'.

leads_router.lead_assignees correctly narrows to logged-in email for scoped sales while returning sales/sales_manager/marketing_admin for elevated roles; recommend surfacing 'inactive' users are excluded (verify seed users active).
CustomerContractTab surfaces sync-ok/issue badges, term & cost rows and delegates BPHTB editing to CostsDialog which reloads the tab — persistence verified round-trip on the UI.

ManualComplaintDialog reuses the same dialog on both customer profile (customer prelocked → no search) and global /complaints page (customer search visible) — a nicely single-source-of-truth component.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient leads (TEST prefix), a manual complaint on customer 666796c3-… and BPHTB cost on contract KTR/2026/0004; verify_scheme_sync.py creates isolated demo lead+deal+contract+plan per run. No production data mutated beyond expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite runs standalone with `pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iter40_sipro.py`. Cost dialog BPHTB is the first input in the dialog; contract box lists Rp 36.500.000 after save. Reservation dialog is under lead /leads/{id} tab 'Unit & SPR' for Akuisisi-stage leads (Menang-stage leads don't display it). scheme options are formatted '<name> · <kind_label>'. verify_scheme_sync.py prints 'customer <uuid>' as the last line — regex should match ^customer.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all requested behaviours verified end-to-end.
